system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global mapped land surface; analyses may be restricted to tropical terrestrial regions and valid mapped-land pixels with the `datamask` band.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2000-01-01 to 2020-01-01; baseline canopy cover is for 2000 and loss-year codes cover 2001-2019
data_description.temporal_unit: Annual loss-year classification within a static multiband image
analytical_capabilities: Map percent tree-canopy cover for the year 2000
Create threshold-based forest masks from baseline canopy cover
Locate stand-replacement tree-cover loss and identify its detected year from 2001 through 2019
Aggregate loss area by year, interval, region, or baseline canopy-cover class
Use the first- and last-period Landsat spectral composites as contextual reference imagery

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: `treecover2000` is tree-canopy cover in percent; `loss` and `gain` are binary indicators; `lossyear` is an integer year code; `datamask` is a categorical validity and water mask.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use `treecover2000` directly in its documented 0-100 percent range; no scale factor is specified. For a 30% forest definition, require `treecover2000 >= 30`. `loss` uses 0 for no loss and 1 for loss. `lossyear` uses 0 for no detected loss and values 1-19 for years 2001-2019. `gain` only represents gain during 2000-2012 and was not updated afterward. `datamask` values are 0=no data, 1=mapped land, and 2=permanent water. This exact catalog asset is deprecated, so availability must be checked before execution; later Hansen versions are not numerically guaranteed to reproduce v1.7.

data_description.data_source: Hansen/University of Maryland/Google/USGS/NASA, derived from Landsat time-series analysis
